candidates.description: The deprecated Snowpark connection class and the 'snowpark' connection type were removed.
candidates.source_quote: The deprecated Snowpark connection type has been removed. Migrate to a supported connection type

candidates.description: The deprecated st.bokeh_chart command was removed.
candidates.source_quote: The deprecated st.bokeh_chart command has been removed.

candidates.description: A keyed st.data_editor with num_rows='fixed' now derives its widget identity from the key and data schema instead of the full data.
candidates.source_quote: st.data_editor now uses key as the primary row identity when num_rows="fixed"

candidates.description: The deprecated use_column_width parameter of st.image was removed in favour of width.
candidates.source_quote: Breaking change: The deprecated use_column_width parameter has been removed from st.image.

candidates.description: st.html no longer loads a local file when given a string path; only pathlib.Path loads files.
candidates.source_quote: Breaking change: Passing local file paths as strings to st.html and st.iframe is deprecated.

candidates.description: st.iframe no longer loads a local file when given a string path; only pathlib.Path loads files.
candidates.source_quote: Use a pathlib.Path object to load local files instead

candidates.description: The long-deprecated st.cache decorator was removed.
candidates.source_quote: The long-deprecated st.cache command has been removed; use st.cache_data or st.cache_resource instead

candidates.description: st.pyplot can no longer be called without a figure (no global-figure fallback); fig is required.
candidates.source_quote: Calling st.pyplot without an explicit figure is no longer supported

candidates.description: st.rerun called inside a widget callback now triggers a rerun instead of being a warned no-op.
candidates.source_quote: st.rerun() and st.switch_page() now take effect inside widget callbacks instead of being discarded

candidates.description: st.switch_page called inside a widget callback now navigates instead of being a warned no-op.
candidates.source_quote: apps that relied on the previous no-op will now rerun

candidates.description: AppTest widget interactions (set_value and the helpers built on it) now raise on disabled widgets.
candidates.source_quote: interacting with a disabled widget raises

candidates.description: AppTest.query_params now holds single values as strings rather than one-item lists.
candidates.source_quote: AppTest.query_params returns single values as strings instead of one-item lists
